description: Principles of engineering science and design applied to practical projects undertaken by student teams. Integrated development and demonstration of writing, research, design and presentation skills. Referencing methods for scientific and technical literature. Characteristics of effective technical and scientific style. Emphasis on clarity, precision, and consistency. Practical experience in writing short technical documents such as memoranda, letters, abstracts, reports, papers, manuals, brochures, and specifications.
